Add parsley - toss - to coat well.

title: Fiesta Fruit Salad
directions: Dressing: Combine lime juice, oil, white wine vinegar, sugar & coriander using wire whisk, slowly stir in whip cream, until well blended, refrig. until ready to use.
Combine lettuce, oranges, pineapple & strawberries. Can sprinkle c poppy seed.
Serve c lime drsg.
Options: Can add orange, mango, apple, pear, or melon. - butter lettuce or romaine -

title: Avocado & Papaya Salad
directions: Mix dressing ingred. in blender until papaya seeds are size of cracked pepper.

1 Papaya
1 Avocado
Dressing

1/4 c sugar

title: Potato Salad
directions: Peel & boil potatoes until tender. Grate.
Combine c salt & celery seed.
Mix milk & salad dressing. Add to potatoes.
Add sliced radishes, chopped chives & eggs & combine.
Sprinkle top of salad c paprika if desired.
raw_text:
Potato Salad.    serves (4)  re Mary Ann.
1 lb potatoes          1/2 miracle whip light
1/4 tsp salt           3 radishes (more or less)
1/4 " celery seed.     2 tbsp. chopped chives.
3/8 c milk             3 eggs hard boiled & chopped.
Peel & boil potatoes until tender. Grate. Combine c
salt & celery seed. Mix milk & salad dressing.
Add to potatoes. Add sliced radishes, chopped chives &
eggs & combine. Sprinkle top of salad c paprika.
if desired.

title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Cool till jelled.
Mix 1 can fruit cocktail undrained & 1 box pistachio inst. pudding - add to jello.
Add 1/2 c nuts & 1 c miniature marshmallows.
Fold in 1 - 9 oz Cool Whip.
raw_text:

1 box lime jello
1 c hot water

Cool till Jelled

Mix 1 can fruit cocktail undrained & 1 box
pistachio inst. pudding - add to Jello.

Add 1/2 c nuts & 1 c miniature marshmallows.
Fold in 1 - 9 oz Cool whip

title: Better Than Potato Salad
directions: In a lg. bowl combine rice, radishes, eggs, cucumber, celery & onion.
Combine mayonnaise, mustard & salt; mix well. Pour over rice mixture & toss.
Cover & refrigerate at least 1 hr.
raw_text:
Better Than Potato Salad:
4 c cooked long grain rice        1/2 c chopped onion
8 radishes sliced                1 1/2 c mayonnaise
4 hard-cooked eggs, chopped.     3 tbsp. prepared mustard
1 med. cucumber seeded & chopped.  3/4 tsp. salt.
2 c thinly sliced celery.

In a lg. bowl combine rice, radishes, eggs, cucumber, celery & onion.
Combine mayonnaise, mustard & salt; mix well. Pour over rice
mixture & toss. Cover & refrigerate at least 1 hr.   12-14 servings

title: Romaine c Oranges & Pecans
directions: Place lettuce, oranges & pecans in salad bowl.
Combine vinegar, oil, sugar, salt, onion, mustard & water in blender. Blend till well mixed.
Make ahead & refrigerate until ready to toss salad.
(Don't use all the dressing. Can be set aside & used as dip for fresh fruit)

directions: Drain pineapple chunks, reserving 1 Tbsp syrup.

title: Party Salad
directions: Add both pkgs. gelatin to the hot water and stir until dissolved.
Add entire contents of can of pineapple.
Cool, then stir in sour cream, celery, and shrimp.
Pour into 2 qt. mold and chill.
Turn out on plate, tuck lettuce under edges, and garnish with cottage cheese and mayon[naise].

title: Cranberry Sour Cream Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Cool thoroughly before folding in cream.
Add 1 c chopped celery, 1 c chopped pecans.
notes: Preprinted 'A PURR-FECT RECIPE' card with cat illustration
